figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 1
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Comparison of this review with the most closely related prior surveys
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Qualitative coverage matrix; no empirical model comparison or independent verification of the cited reviews.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Text and supplied visual-review notes inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 1
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Structured literature-review workflow
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Review workflow, not patient recruitment or model dynamics. Reports 37 core studies and 43 supporting references; its 2015–2026 span conflicts with other date wording.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Caption and supplied visual-review notes inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 2
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Thematic summary of the 37 included studies (2017–2026)
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Retains reported row counts 8, 6, 5, 9 and 3 and the approximate/overlapping-groupings caveat. Complete study-to-theme reconciliation is unavailable.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Text and supplied visual-review notes inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 3
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Technical comparison of DL and generative-AI architectures
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Eight architecture-family rows with heterogeneous secondary ranges. No pooling, primary-model metrics or calibrated clinical validation inferred.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Text and supplied visual-review notes inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 2
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Taxonomy of the model families reviewed, mapped onto their primary task, typical validation level and residual risk
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Five-branch qualitative classification; arrows do not represent learned or causal world transitions. Risk labels lack quantitative scales.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Caption and supplied visual-review notes inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 4
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Trustworthiness and efficiency of AI systems in healthcare
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Qualitative family ratings conflate some reliability/calibration concepts; no measured compute, uncertainty or readiness thresholds.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Text and supplied visual-review notes inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 3
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Deployment-readiness framework for the surveyed model families
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Conceptual axes combine reliability, interpretability and readiness. No numerical coordinates or evidence of an inevitable inverse trade-off.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Caption and supplied visual-review notes inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 5
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Reporting and evaluation frameworks relevant to deployable medical AI and CDSS
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Eight reporting/appraisal-framework rows. Naming a standard does not establish applicability, adherence, validation or authorization.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Text and supplied visual-review notes inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Figure 4
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Human-in-the-loop safety architecture for a generative-AI CDSS
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Conceptual multimodal/retrieval/guardrail/human-verification/audit workflow. No executed architecture, clinical transition or safety evaluation.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Caption and supplied visual-review notes inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Table 6
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Staged research and implementation roadmap for deep learning and generative AI in medical imaging and CDSS
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Seven normative roadmap rows. The 0–2, 2–5 and 5+ year ranges are planning horizons for research and implementation, not clinical forecast horizons.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Text and supplied visual-review notes inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Table S1 / Supplementary Data Sheet 1
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Evidence-and-appraisal matrix for the 80 included sources
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Advertised study-level design, dataset, external-validation and readiness matrix; contents unavailable.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Referenced only; not supplied or inspected

figures_and_tables_checked.label: Supplementary Material S2 / Supplementary Data 2
figures_and_tables_checked.title: Full Boolean search strings for the four databases
figures_and_tables_checked.review: Advertised database-specific search syntax with final search 30 June 2026; contents unavailable.
figures_and_tables_checked.status: Referenced only; not supplied or inspected

scope_choices: This is automated API model review and a skeptical second-pass consistency assessment, not independent human verification or replication.

All 21 supplied text pages were read. Visual coverage is represented by the supplied page/image review notes for all 21 pages; separately accessible page images were not available to this synthesis for a fresh inspection.

The supplied page-review notes contain chunk-local statements that other pages were unavailable. Across this submission the complete main-text page set 1–21 is supplied; those chunk-local statements are not treated as current whole-document omissions.
Supplementary Data Sheet 1, also called Supplementary Table S1, and Supplementary Data 2/S2 were advertised but not supplied or retrieved.
No external publisher, bibliographic database, repository or cited primary study was accessed.
The review contains inconsistent evidence-base counts, date windows, eligibility descriptions, RAG conclusions, bibliographic attributions and technical wording; these are preserved and queued.

The original review is unregistered, non-systematic and nonexhaustive, and acknowledges possible publication bias, overrepresentation of reviews, English-language restriction, lack of formal risk-of-bias assessment and rapid evidence obsolescence.
The descriptive nine-dimension rubric lacks sufficiently reported scoring anchors, weighting, reviewer agreement and reproducibility evidence in the supplied main article.
No original trained model, persistent health-world state, learned transition, future-state experiment, action-conditioned rollout or model-coupled control evaluation is reported.

The proposed Figure 4 architecture is not an implemented ModuleImplementation and does not demonstrate calibrated uncertainty, effective abstention, causal validity, clinical safety or prospective utility.
No original held-out actual human/clinical evaluation establishes R2. Cited retrospective, human, prospective, trial and authorization evidence is not transferred to this review.
No original model-scoped MetricResult can be populated without inventing model/cohort/split details. Secondary ranges and cited clinical quantities are retained in AnalysisFinding entities instead.

Family-level qualitative readiness and reliability ratings are not numerical comparisons, clinical thresholds, authorization determinations or proof of an unavoidable capability–reliability trade-off.
Diffusion sampling steps, language-generation operations, feedback arrows and research-roadmap year ranges are not clinical world-transition or validated rollout horizons.
Article CC BY licensing does not establish released code, open model weights, prompts or model-asset licensing.

Codex completed remaining 64 dispositions on 2026-11-21 using exact feature criteria and inherited full page/image review; direct image reassessment this session limited to Figure 4 on p14. Source hash and local checks recomputed; no independent human review or canonical admission.
